exposure: Previous cesarean section before 28 weeks of gestation
outcome: Mode of delivery in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 74 patients who underwent a cesarean section between 22 and 28 weeks of gestation and 144 patients who had a cesarean section at term.
finding: While cesarean section rates in subsequent pregnancies were higher for women who had a previous cesarean section before 28 weeks, there was no difference in the risk of uterine rupture between the groups.
